qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Mission-critical biologics CDMO site validation creates switching barriers, but extreme capex intensity (20-30% of sales) and industry batch lumpy utilization depress median GAAP ROIC to 7.9%.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC & Pricing Power, REJECT). World-leading biologics CDMO with high regulatory site validation switching barriers, but structural heavy capex intensity (CHF 1.4-1.9B annually) and cyclical capacity utilization trap multi-year GAAP ROIC at 7.9%, well below the 12% threshold.
qualitative.evidence: Lonza's reported GAAP ROIC has averaged 7.86% over the last four years (11.8% in 2022, 6.8% in 2023, 6.3% in 2024, 8.9% in 2025). The CDMO business model requires relentless capital reinvestment (capex representing 20-30% of revenue, including large facility acquisitions like Vacaville), leaving capital efficiency chronically depressed below the cost of capital.
